subject: Sprint gating: security asks for audit evidence, SSO & KMS scope — align
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MediSprint ask: audit evidence + KMS/SSO clarifications

Hi team —

Nicole Evans at MediSprint pinged product with a short list of gating items they need before we can enable them in the sandbox pilot:

- Audit evidence: retention windows, log schema, sample export. (They attached a spreadsheet with the required fields; see attachment)
- KMS/BYOK: they want to know whether customer-managed keys can be scoped per-tenant or only global keys.
- SSO: they need confirmation of assertion attributes (email, sub) and a diagram of the login flow.

Can we clarify what is realistically shipable in the current sprint vs. what needs a roadmap item? Important to keep MediSprint in the pilot timeframe (requested date: Nov 30).

Attachments: audit_requirements_2026.xlsx

Thanks —
Grace

Grace O'Connor
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Nicole Evans <nicole@medisprint.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MediSprint ask: audit evidence + KMS/SSO clarifications

Thanks Grace — looping in product and security leads to align scope.

Quick take (high level):
- Audit evidence: we can produce a CSV export of the audit events and a retention matrix for the next sprint (low risk). Generating a filtered sample export for compliance review is doable but will require a small backend job — estimate 1 sprint.
- KMS/BYOK: per-tenant CMK is not supported today; we have tenant-key scoping on the backlog (architecture exists) but it'll be ~2 sprints to expose safely with KMS rotation integration.
- SSO attributes & flow: Jonas, can you confirm whether we can produce a diagram and the attribute list this week? If so, I can send a short note to Nicole about which items are on the short path vs. roadmap.

Action items I propose before I respond to MediSprint:
1) Jonas: confirm SSO attributes + attach a flow diagram (sso_flow_diagram.png) — due Thu EOD
2) Grace: prepare the minimal audit export sample template (use her spreadsheet) — due Fri
3) Marissa: advise if product can accept a partial delivery (audit matrix + SSO diagram now, KMS per-tenant as roadmap) and whether that meets MediSprint's pilot gating.

I'll set a 30-minute sync to finalize the reply — available Fri morning PST.

— Hiro
Hiro Tanaka
Product Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MediSprint ask: audit evidence + KMS/SSO clarifications

Hiro —

Agree with the proposed split. A few clarifications from product side:

- The pilot success criteria we've committed to can be met if we deliver the audit matrix + a representative sample (not the full export) and a documented SSO attribute list. That should unblock their security review.
- We should not promise per-tenant CMK in writing. Instead, offer a roadmap milestone with approximate timeline and signpost potential limitations (no live key rotation for tenant keys in pilot).
- For customer-facing comms, we should provide a short 'what we can deliver now' doc and a 'roadmap & constraints' appendix.

I can draft the customer note once Grace and Jonas deliver their artifacts. Resource note: engineering can scope the sample export as a hotfix if it's strictly a filtered dump; otherwise it'll be a sprint task.

Marissa

Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MediSprint ask: audit evidence + KMS/SSO clarifications

Hi —

SSO attribute list below (confirmed):
- sub (stable subject id)
- email (verified)
- name (optional)
- groups (if requested, via LDAP mapping)

I attached a lightweight flow diagram showing where assertions hit our gateway and which events we log (see sso_flow_diagram.png). On KMS:
- Current system: a cluster-level CMK stored in our KMS; tenants are namespaced but keys are shared.
- Per-tenant CMK: needs HSM/KMS multi-key management + access control changes. Estimate: design spike (1 week) + implementation (2 sprints) + ops handoff.

For the audit export, ensure fields include: event_time, tenant_id, user_id, action, request_id, resource, outcome, ip_address. If Grace's spreadsheet misses any, flag them.

I'll attach the diagram and can join the sync.

Jonas Weber
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sso_flow_diagram.png
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Nicole Evans <nicole@medisprint.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MediSprint ask: audit evidence + KMS/SSO clarifications — proposed reply and sync

Nicole —

Thanks for the ask and the spreadsheet. We're aligning internally. Short plan:

- What we can deliver before Nov 30: audit retention matrix + representative sample export (CSV) and an SSO attributes & flow diagram.
- Roadmap items: per-tenant CMK (BYOK) is on our backlog and requires ~2 sprints to support safely; we cannot commit to it for the pilot.

Internal: please review and confirm the artifacts below. Once I'm green on those, I'll send the official note to MediSprint and attach the short appendix called 'roadmap & constraints'.

Proposed sync: Fri 11/13 10:00 AM PST (I'll send a calendar invite). If that doesn't work, here is a Doodle for alternatives: https://doodle.com/poll/abcd1234

Thanks —
Hiro

Hiro Tanaka
Product Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
